title: PAUSE YOUR DAY
FIND STILLNESS
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlight streaming through a window onto a wooden floor
a quiet desk with a closed journal and a cup of tea
high sun over a vast open field with gentle breeze
dappled light filtering through green tree leaves
soft light reflecting on a glass of water
peaceful shadows lengthening on a clean wall

scenes.a: Take a moment to pause whatever you are doing right now.
The world is noisy and fast, but this midday hour is for you to rest.
In the scripture of Psalm 55:17, we find these words: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
Let us offer a simple prayer together in this quiet space today.
Heavenly Father, thank you for this midday moment of quiet reflection.
Grant us the wisdom to hear your voice clearly amidst the busy day.
